audit_metadata.title: Guardian Alpha V30 Stage 2H-B - Adversarial Review & Falsification Register
audit_metadata.auditor_role: Adversarial Software Verification Engineer & Quantitative Auditor

falsification_investigations.test_performed: Scanned all engine and strategy files for socket, urllib, requests, httpx, aiohttp imports.
falsification_investigations.finding: Zero hidden network calls. In-process monkey-patching prevents Python library egress. Explicit disclosure recorded that Python patching does not block OS subprocesses.

falsification_investigations.test_performed: Tested DecimalAccountingOracle across 10 adversarial crash, settlement delay, and split scenarios.
falsification_investigations.finding: Equity balance sheet identity (Assets - Liabilities = Flow Equity) holds exactly with 0.0000 residual in all cases.

falsification_investigations.test_performed: Simulated repeated order fill events and duplicate dividend notifications.
falsification_investigations.finding: Double-crediting is prevented by transaction ID idempotency and explicit state updates.

falsification_investigations.test_performed: Injected mode='live' and mode='paper_live' into activation guard.
falsification_investigations.finding: Live mode immediately triggers persistent hard-stop; zero execution allowed.

falsification_investigations.test_performed: Scrutinized legal terms of Tiingo, Polygon, Alpaca, and IBKR for personal vs commercial redistribution.
falsification_investigations.finding: Stage 2H-A blanket claim was over-generalized. Corrected in Stage 2H-B: personal plans allow internal private modeling only; redistribution is banned. India-based cross-border restrictions on margin/derivatives documented.

falsification_investigations.test_performed: Evaluated power of N=30 defensive sessions under realistic equity variance (sigma = 80 bps/day, HAC VIF = 1.25).
falsification_investigations.finding: Stage 2H-A claim that N=30 is fully sufficient was over-optimistic. Power for subtle effect (20 bps) is only ~35%; MDE at 80% power is 45.4 bps. N=30 is an asymptotic minimal floor, not a high-power guarantee.

falsification_investigations.test_performed: Checked whether historical candidate selection altered preregistered hypotheses.
falsification_investigations.finding: Preregistration is frozen and immutable; all 43 prior variants disclosed as historical selection bias.

falsification_investigations.test_performed: Simulated missing market bar during daily rebalance.
falsification_investigations.finding: Engine preserves existing position or holds cash without crashing; logs CRITICAL alert.

falsification_investigations.test_performed: Reconciled CAGR, drawdown, and Sharpe definitions between preview, host, and oracle.
falsification_investigations.finding: Host sell-first sequencing identified as authoritative over naive list ordering.

falsification_investigations.test_performed: Verified exact test IDs, commands, environments, and exit codes for all suites.
falsification_investigations.finding: Full executed test ledger maintained with zero omitted tests.

falsification_investigations.test_performed: Verified git status and file existence of all prior reports from V29E through V30 2H-A.
falsification_investigations.finding: Zero files overwritten or deleted. 84 research artifacts preserved in untracked state.

falsification_investigations.test_performed: Audited pytest execution history and background task outputs.
falsification_investigations.finding: All executed tests completed with exit code 0; zero concealed failures.

falsification_investigations.test_performed: Recomputed SHA256 hashes of agent.py, universe.json, v12_candidate_ae.py, v30_candidate_d2_cash_cushion.py.
